Definition
[Moving plane notation] 1. ch9:9.5.2-def-1\group Maximum Principles

  1. If $0 \le \lambda \le 1$, define the plane

    \[ P_\lambda := \{ x \in \R ^n \mid x_n = \lambda \} . \]

  2. Write $x_\lambda := (x_1, \ldots , x_{n-1}, 2\lambda - x_n)$ to denote the reflection of $x$ in $P_\lambda $.

  3. $E_\lambda := \{ x \in U \mid \lambda < x_n < 1\} $.
